decision: Both Stage 0 and Stage 1 use the true future measured-window encoding as the z supervision target.
rule: For Stage 0, compare the one-step propagated latent state with g_theta(X_{k+1}^{data}) from the same measured trajectory.
For Stage 1, compare every recursively propagated latent state with g_theta(X_{k+i}^{data}) from the same measured trajectory.
The target encoding branch is training-only; deployment still encodes the initial history once and recursively propagates z.
The joint objective supervises x and complete z; it does not establish the uniform residual assumption A3.
scope: Training objective semantics and alignment with the existing z^E residual definition.
boundary: No stability, observability, generalization, or closed-loop guarantee is added.
Loss weights, normalization, and target-branch gradient policy remain unresolved.
